INSERT INTO `farm_task`
user_id, plot_id, batch_id, task_title, task_type, task_content, priority, deadline_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, status, executor_id, complete_remark, remark, source_type, source_id, ai_solution_id,
#{userId}, #{plotId}, #{batchId}, #{taskTitle}, #{taskType}, #{taskContent}, #{priority}, #{deadlineTime}, #{actualStartTime}, #{actualEndTime}, #{status}, #{executorId}, #{completeRemark}, #{remark}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{aiSolutionId},
mapper.update: UPDATE `farm_task` SET status = #{status}, actual_start_time = COALESCE(#{actualStartTime}, actual_start_time), actual_end_time = COALESCE(#{actualEndTime}, actual_end_time), complete_remark = COALESCE(#{completeRemark}, complete_remark) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `farm_task` SET status = 2, executor_id = #{executorId}, actual_start_time = COALESCE(actual_start_time, #{actualStartTime}) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 4) AND (executor_id IS NULL OR executor_id = #{executorId})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `farm_task` ft
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ft.task_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND ft.status != 5
AND ft.status = 1 AND (ft.deadline_time IS NULL OR ft.deadline_time >= NOW())
AND ft.status = 2 AND (ft.deadline_time IS NULL OR ft.deadline_time >= NOW())
AND ft.status = 3
AND (ft.status = 4 OR (ft.status IN (1, 2) AND ft.deadline_time < NOW()))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ft.status = 4 OR (ft.status IN (1, 2) AND ft.deadline_time < NOW()) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ft.deadline_time ASC, ft.id DESC

SELECT FROM `farm_task` ft
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ft.plot_id = #{plotId} AND ft.task_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) ORDER BY ft.deadline_time ASC, ft.id ASC

SELECT DATE(ft.deadline_time) AS task_date, COUNT(1) AS task_count FROM `farm_task` ft WHERE 1 = 1
AND ft.task_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND ft.deadline_time >= #{deadlineStart} AND ft.deadline_time <= #{deadlineEnd} GROUP BY DATE(ft.deadline_time)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.status IN (1, 2, 4) AND ft.deadline_time < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdueCount FROM `farm_task` ft WHERE 1 = 1
AND ft.task_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
SELECT id FROM `planting_batch` WHERE plot_id = #{plotId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY planted_at DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_type = 'AI_SOLUTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aiGeneratedCount FROM `farm_task`
AND user_id = #{userId}
